planning_notes: PWM fan output is wired to D5 and remains unchanged.

The original requirement cited LM35 on A1, but the resolved authoritative configuration used analog input A0. To repair the contract error about the omitted physical pin, an additional analog_input request on A1 is added while keeping the existing A0 analog_input request unchanged.
Threshold logic (temperature > 30C => fan ON else OFF) and any °C conversion/calibration are handled in the SysML model; sampling period is not specified, so the catalog default applies.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Fan PWM command (ON when temperature > 30C, otherwise OFF)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: LM35 temperature sensor reading (requested A1 pin override)
